organization.name: Health Resources in Action (HRiA)
organization.notes: Company website not supplied. Links open the source listing; confirm all requirements with the employer.

input.description: Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive. HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values: Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression. Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission. Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust. Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities. Biomedical Research Grantmaking is a department within the broader Grantmaking Cluster at HRiA that facilitates biomedical sciences grantmaking services. The Biomedical Research Grantmaking team provides strategic advising of the design and administration of investments in biomedical sciences to a range of clients and partners. With a team of eleven staff members situated across the country, Biomedical Research Grantmaking works with private individuals, bank trusts and family foundations to provide biomedical and life science consulting services, program evaluation, and customized grant programs designed to accelerate medical discoveries. In 2025, we facilitated biomedical research grant programs that awarded over $22 million to outstanding investigators across the United States. HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 300 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood. Position Description The Program Officer, Biomedical Research Grantmaking (Program Officer) seeks to advance health by working as part of a team to create, manage, and evaluate grant programs that support biomedical research. This project management role includes responsibility for developing, executing, managing, and evaluating competitive award programs and other ad hoc activities. The position requires the ability to develop and maintain relationships with awardees, scientific advisory committees, staff, clients, biomedical societies, and institutions. The Program Officer will also need to occasionally travel on behalf of HRiA. The Program Officer will help the HRiA team achieve the goals of its partners in philanthropy by drawing upon their scientific training/background to support the strategic research program oversight of the Grantmaking team. This includes understanding and translating biomedical research (e.g., datasets, primary research articles, and reviews) to a wide range of audiences to support the development of deliverables such as landscape scans, program evaluations, and documentation of meeting outcomes. They will also work with Grantmaking leadership and staff to design and implement approaches that leverage strengths and overcome barriers in the advancement of health equity across multiple life sciences funding initiatives and projects. The Program Officer will work as part of a grantmaking team that includes Executive and Senior Leadership, Directors, Grants Officers, Scientific Officers, Grants Associates, and Grants Coordinators for both Biomedical Research Grantmaking (biomedical focus) and Community Health Grantmaking projects. This is a full-time, exempt position. This position is fully remote. General Responsibilities Management : The Program Officer will serve as a project manager for multiple projects within the Grantmaking portfolio. They will manage timelines and deliverables for grantmaking processes, including peer review and pre- and post-award activities. In doing so, the Program Officer may provide programmatic/project oversight of Grants Coordinators and Associates. Project Work: The Program Officer works with team members to apply their scientific knowledge to the creation and implementation of tools and materials for biomedical research funding opportunities, evaluations, and landscape scans. The Program Officer will help to ensure that applicants and awardees of funding opportunities advance the mission of their philanthropic funders. The Program Officer is expected to be a clear, timely, and professional communicator in serving as a liaison with external stakeholders including clients, applicants, awardees, and reviewers. Business Development: The Program Officer will support the writing of proposals, blog posts, and client communications. They will help develop the scope of work and associated budgets for new business and existing projects. Thought Leadership: The Program Officer is expected to keep abreast of advances in biomedical research and share trends with the Grantmaking team. They will actively participate in professional networks relevant to biomedical research and in professional development activities to develop skills and expertise that align with evolving approaches in biomedical research grantmaking. They may be asked to help build content for the HRiA website or participate in relevant workgroups in grantmaking. Benefits This is a full-time, exempt position at 35-40+ hours per week. The salary range for this position is $65,000-$72,000 and is commensurate with experience and credentials. HRiA offers an attractive benefits package including employer-funded medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, and employer contributions to a tax-deferred annuity. Additionally, employees enjoy flexible work schedules and other policies that promote work/life balance, vacation starting at four weeks, paid family and medical leave, 13 paid holidays, plus office closure time for the last week of December. HRiA seeks candidates nationally. The Program Officer will be required to travel for various programmatic activities, including regular Massachusetts-based events. Duties & Responsibilities The below described duties and responsibilities are intended to indicate the kinds of work that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under their supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty. Project Management Develop timelines and comprehensive project or workplans to ensure timely completion of deliverables using tools such as Asana and Microsoft Suite Products; Ensure accurate tracking of project progress, effective scheduling of meetings, and prioritization of activities; Maintain organization of all project materials throughout the duration of the project period; Develop and uphold communication coordination for project teams, clients, and other external stakeholders; Liaise with vendors as needed for events management, video production, catering, etc.; Assist with oversight of project budgets; Ensure timely completion of requests related to post-award reporting, funding distribution, client related inquiries, and applicant/awardee questions. Scientific Activities Work with the senior Science Officer to curate biomedical research content for grant programs such as Requests for Applications, application guidelines, reviewer guidance, funding opportunity marketing, and awardee announcements; Conduct research including literature reviews, key informant interviews, and survey development to support the completion of research landscape and funding scans; Work with the Science Officer to identify potential scientific reviewers to serve on panels and committees; Support the development of reports for clients and other external-facing materials such as blogs, publications, and lay summaries of scientific reports; Manage and complete due diligence and first tier review of grant applications and review grantee reporting requirements such as progress reports and final reports; Co-facilitate office hours, scientific peer review meetings, and strategic discussions. Relationship Management Serve as a liaison for applicants, awardees, and reviewers in providing technical assistance, guidance, and problem resolution; Serve and maintain client communications; providing clear, concise, and accurate information as requested to develop trusted relationships; Maintain relationships with organizations engaged in overlapping professional networks; Be an active contributor to internal organizational committees and staff meetings as appropriate. General Activities Research potential opportunities and contribute to proposal development (help identify potential new clients and projects, support the writing of proposals, etc.); Assist in the development of proposed scope of work and associated budgets for new business and existing projects Candidate Qualifications A minimum of 5 years of experience in a related field such as philanthropy, development, or biomedical research; A master’s degree in a biomedical related field such as biology, chemistry, neuroscience, genetics, etc. is preferred; A PhD in biomedical research and/or previous experience in grants management is advantageous but not required; A demonstrated understanding and commitment to operationalizing health and racial equity principles in grantmaking practices and/or approaches to biomedical research; A commitment to value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives; A commitment to a growth mindset, flexibility, and iteration and learning in their approach to solving problems; Ability to manage multiple projects; Proficiency in or capability of learning new software, including Asana, Adobe Acrobat, Microsoft Suite including Excel, SmartSimple grants management software, WordPress, Video Conferencing/Calling; Ability to work as part of a team and self-starter; Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to high-quality work; Excellent organizational, critical thinking, and interpersonal skills; Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Procedure for Candidacy HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Diversity is a core value of HRiA resulting in culturally competent services, materials, resources, and programs. Our hiring and business practices appreciate the strengths offered through different backgrounds. HRiA is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. input.description: WHO WE ARE We’re Hook —an award-winning creative content agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team and an emphasis on production-led design, we make ads, campaigns, and experiences that drive growth for the world’s most innovative brands. Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster, but we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet. WHAT’S A SENIOR ART DIRECTOR AT HOOK? A great Senior Art Director is a creative, highly collaborative talent who excels at balancing hands-on design craft with creative direction. They are a positive, inspiring partner who is a joy to work with. Solves complex marketing challenges through solid conceptual thinking and exceptional design. They are proficient at establishing trust with clients, confidently presenting creative work, and leading projects from ideation through execution alongside motion designers, writers, and motion designers. They have experience in digital marketing, social media landscapes, production, and technology. They have a highly collaborative creative process to generate successful, visually stunning advertising solutions. Develop an understanding of the client’s products, UI features, and target audiences. This retained brand knowledge enables them to translate complex product features into clear, engaging stories. A Senior AD actively supports the ACD team on pitching, ideation, and design, keeping projects running smoothly and proactively identifying potential issues before they disrupt a project. WHAT YOU’LL DO Hands-on Concepting & Execution: Collaborate with a writing partner to develop insight-driven creative concepts, executing the visual design to a standard that exceeds client expectations. Design & Concepting: This role entails creating and guiding visually appealing designs and concepts, coming up with ideas and making content for social and digital campaigns. It will be important even when working with tight budgets. Client Relationships: Establish and maintain positive relationships with all relevant client contacts, becoming an expert on brand culture, politics, products, preferences, and expectations. Team Collaboration: Collaborate with Design and Motion teams to refine and adjust processes to push the work further and find efficiencies. Communication: Be a clear and effective communicator to the team and trusted partner to the production team Creative Partnership: Partner with a Senior Copywriter and create inspiring work that drives storytelling across media Presentations: Lead the development and presentation of pitch materials for all major and complex campaigns associated with a brand or brand group High Quality: Ensure the highest possible quality of all strategic, creative, and design deliverables within the scope of one or more brand relationships Push the Work: Elevate overall work quality by setting increasingly high standards and articulating ambitious creative opportunities (without sacrificing baseline deliverable requirements) Work Relationships: Cultivate positive relationships with Design, Copywriting, Motion and Production. Team Cultural Impact: Promote a positive creative culture through teamwork, positive attitude, and leading by example. Travel: Ability to travel and support photo and video shoots depending on briefs WHAT YOU’LL NEED 5+ years of creative agency or production company experience across a variety of campaign types Hands-on design experience is a must. This person will be expected to step in and support design and be able to give pixel perfect design feedback to other members of the team Familiarity with motion graphics and ability to collaborate with motion designers and give clear direction Bonus points if you also have hands on brand design and/or motion design experience Strong portfolio that demonstrates your ability to solve complex marketing challenges with diverse tones and for various industries, especially with digital and social-first projects Ability to tell a clear, engaging story using UI features and visuals, understanding of key benefits to users and how to highlight them with limited assets Keep up with industry developments and AI tools Ability to come up with big idea thinking promoting tech services and products is a plus Experience working with tech or well recognized domestic or international brands is a plus Photo and video shoot support and travel will likely be necessary (about less than 10% of the year). Overnight travel may be required. WHAT ELSE Qualified applicants will include a resume and a statement of interest that allows us to learn a little more about you. We are a remote first organization with a “work from wherever” approach (within the US). We're a collaborative group of people who love the internet, and want to create phenomenal work. Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, and more. At Hook , we value what makes everyone different. We look for the best talent, no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives, which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are. Come join us! Hook believes in equity and compensation transparency. We’ve designed a 10-level advancement framework that’s applied consistently across disciplines and departments, aligning with our location-based salary ranges. This role is leveled as an L5. We’ll review your location, skills, experience, and other relevant factors during the interview process to determine where you fall within our leveling framework and corresponding salary ranges. Please follow this link to learn more. Please review our Transparent Compensation Philosophy. We are not currently considering candidates in the Tier 4 market band for this role at this time. input.description: This is a remote position. About HeyDelegate HeyDelegate is a staffing partner that connects growing US-based companies and agencies with highly skilled professionals from Africa. We go beyond simply filling positions. We thoughtfully match companies with professionals who can integrate into their teams, take ownership of their responsibilities and contribute meaningfully to long-term growth. Our focus is on quality, strong communication, professional maturity and building successful working relationships. As HeyDelegate enters its next stage of growth, we are looking for a Brand & Marketing Lead who can strengthen how the company is positioned, communicated and experienced across every key touchpoint. About the Role This is not a social media management or content coordination position. We are looking for a strategic and hands-on brand marketer who can help define what HeyDelegate should be known for, sharpen how we communicate our value and translate that strategy into compelling campaigns, content and marketing assets. You will work closely with the founder to understand the company’s vision, customers, services and competitive position. You will then take ownership of developing a distinctive brand and marketing direction that supports HeyDelegate ’s growth among US-based agencies and other target companies. The ideal candidate understands that branding is more than visual identity or consistent posting. You should be able to develop positioning, messaging, campaigns and narratives that influence how the market understands and remembers a company. You must also be comfortable executing the strategy. This role requires someone who can move between high-level brand thinking and practical implementation without waiting for a large team or external agency. This will begin as a contract-based engagement, with the opportunity for the scope and level of involvement to expand as the company grows and the working relationship develops. Key Responsibilities Brand Positioning and Strategy Develop and continuously strengthen HeyDelegate ’s brand positioning, value proposition, messaging pillars, audience definition and competitive differentiation. Brand Narrative and Messaging Create clear, distinctive messaging that communicates the quality of HeyDelegate ’s talent, matching process, ongoing support and value as a long-term staffing partner. Campaign Development Develop integrated brand and marketing campaigns that build awareness, credibility and trust among US-based agencies and other target clients. Content Strategy Build and manage a content strategy across LinkedIn, email, the HeyDelegate website, case studies and other relevant channels. Content should be purposeful, insight-led and connected to the company’s broader commercial goals. Website Messaging and Brand Experience Review and improve the structure, messaging and overall brand experience of the HeyDelegate website, ensuring that it clearly communicates the company’s positioning and supports lead generation. Case Studies and Sales Assets Develop strong, proof-based case studies, service materials, presentations and other assets that demonstrate HeyDelegate ’s capabilities and support the sales process. Customer and Market Research Conduct ongoing research into HeyDelegate ’s clients, prospective customers, competitors and market to identify insights that can strengthen the brand and inform future campaigns. Founder and Team Collaboration Work closely with the founder and internal team to extract company insights, customer stories and subject-matter expertise, then translate them into effective brand communications. HeyDelegate should remain the central brand. Creative Direction Provide clear strategic direction for visual assets, photography, video and design to ensure that all creative work supports a consistent and distinctive brand identity. Marketing Execution Personally execute priority marketing initiatives while coordinating with designers, videographers, writers or other external partners where required. Performance Measurement Establish appropriate brand and marketing metrics, evaluate campaign performance and use the findings to improve future strategy and execution. Brand Consistency Ensure that HeyDelegate ’s voice, positioning and presentation remain consistent across marketing, sales, recruitment and client-facing materials. Perform any other related brand and marketing responsibilities that may reasonably be required as the company grows. Requirements At least five years of relevant experience in brand strategy, brand management, strategic marketing, communications strategy or a closely related field. Demonstrated experience helping shape or reposition a brand, not only managing its social media accounts. Strong understanding of brand positioning, audience segmentation, messaging architecture and campaign strategy. Experience translating brand strategy into content, websites, email campaigns, case studies and sales materials. Strong commercial judgment and an understanding of how brand and marketing support business growth. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong research, critical-thinking and storytelling abilities. Ability to work directly with a founder, organize incomplete ideas and turn them into clear strategic direction. Ability to operate independently, make sound decisions and move work forward without constant supervision. Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow briefs and deadlines precisely. A proactive and highly responsive working style. Experience working with B2B service companies, staffing businesses, professional-services firms or agencies would be an advantage. Experience marketing to US-based businesses would be an advantage. Familiarity with website content, SEO, email marketing and marketing analytics is beneficial. Candidates with backgrounds in brand strategy, advertising strategy, account planning, integrated marketing or strategic communications are encouraged to apply. This Role May Not Be Suitable for You If Your experience is primarily limited to scheduling social media posts and creating content calendars. You view branding mainly as logos, colours and visual consistency. You require a fully developed strategy before you can begin executing. You are uncomfortable taking ownership of both strategic thinking and implementation. You rely heavily on generic or AI-generated marketing language without developing an original point of view. You struggle to communicate promptly, follow detailed briefs or meet deadlines. Location This is a remote position. Candidates based in Kenya, particularly those who can occasionally attend in-person meetings or content activities in Nairobi, are strongly preferred. Exceptional candidates based elsewhere in Africa may also be considered. Originally posted on Himalayas

input.description: Column is the software platform for public information. We build automated tools and workflow solutions that help governments, law firms, and media organizations notify the public. Today, thousands of publishers and tens of thousands of agencies, firms, and individuals rely on Column to keep their communities informed every day. We’re reimagining how public information connects people, institutions, and media. We're a remote-first team of engineers, designers, and builders who are committed to creating software that supports an informed public. About the Role Column | Remote (U.S.-based) | Full-Time The Content Marketing Manager will build Column ’s content engine: turning our expertise, customer stories, frontline insight, and national public notice developments into consistent, high-quality content that establishes Column as the expert on, and advocate for, public information, access to it, and public notice. You’ll own the marketing calendar and Column ’s core publishing channels, including our blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, monthly Public Notice reports, educational resources, case studies, and sales collateral. You’ll stay closely connected to our Customer Success and Services teams so our content reflects what is actually happening in the field. As Column invests in SEO, media, partnerships, and demand generation, this role will help establish us as the definitive resource on public notice. We’re looking for a strong writer and steady operator who values quality over quantity, publishes consistently, and writes in a voice that is strong, professional, mature, and trustworthy. Candidates should also be able to move fluidly between long-form thought leadership, visual and video content, CMS publishing, and email campaigns while maintaining a consistent, high-quality publishing cadence. What You’ll Do Own Column ’s marketing calendar and publishing cadence across the blog, newsletters, LinkedIn, email, and internal enablement, managing projects from request through drafting, review, publication, and distribution. Follow public notice and public information news nationally , turning legislation, court decisions, industry shifts, and market trends into timely, credible content, including news commentary for our media channels. Build a content source of truth with CSMs and our Services team (affidavits, pagination, and placement), turning their frontline knowledge into educational resources, FAQs, and enablement materials. Write and produce high-quality content across formats , including weekly SEO blog posts, newsletters, customer case studies, guides, press releases, and sales collateral. Own customer storytelling and case studies , from interviews and data collection through written stories, pull quotes, graphics, and video testimonials, while also supporting partnership announcements and sponsored content opportunities. Create compelling visual and video content for marketing campaigns, social media, YouTube, reports, presentations, one-pagers, conference collateral, and other channels, bringing strong graphic design and video production/editing skills to Column ’s content. Grow Column ’s LinkedIn presence and repurpose content for distribution and conversion , turning reports, customer stories, webinars, product launches, and news commentary into posts, graphics, short video, and email while improving CTAs, lifecycle campaigns, and website performance through testing. What We’re Looking For Exceptional writer and editor who makes complex, legal, or regulatory subjects clear and credible, with a high bar for accuracy and a mature, trustworthy voice. Consistent, organized operator who manages an editorial calendar, juggles multiple projects, and ships on schedule without sacrificing quality. Genuinely news-engaged , with curiosity about government, law, local media, and access to information, and the judgment to know what is worth writing about and when. Experienced B2B content marketer with a track record of blogs, newsletters, case studies, reports, and educational resources. Strong visual judgment and an eye for design , with experience creating polished assets such as reports, PDFs, presentations, social creative, email graphics, and sales collateral. Digitally fluent and performance-minded , with experience publishing in a CMS, understanding SEO fundamentals, and using data, testing, and conversion insights to improve content and campaigns. Collaborative and comfortable becoming an expert , able to interview customers, CSMs, operators, and leadership and translate what they know into clear content. What Success Looks Like Key performance indicators will include: Consistent publishing cadence: Approximately 1 blog post per week, 1 LinkedIn post per week, 1 newsletter per month, 1 Public Notice report per month, 1 case study per month. Campaign and channel support: Timely press releases, webinar and lifecycle communications, conference collateral, sales enablement, and social distribution tied to major launches, partnerships, events, and customer stories. Authority and education: Column ’s blog, reports, and resources become a go-to reference on public notice and public information, and Sales, CSMs, and Services actively use them. You also establish a reliable monthly loop with internal teams to surface trends, customer questions, and field insights into published content. Audience growth: Growth in organic traffic, newsletter engagement, LinkedIn followers and engagement, and gated resource downloads. Business impact: Clear attribution between content and pipeline, showing which blogs, newsletters, reports, case studies, and posts generate and influence marketing leads. Editorial execution: Maintain a clear content calendar, independently manage recurring workflows. Ensure content moves efficiently from idea through publication and distribution. Content repurposing: Major webinars, research, case studies, product education, and customer conversations are consistently turned into multiple useful formats across web, email, LinkedIn, video, and sales enablement. Your First 90 Days First 60 Days: Learn Column and Build the Foundation The first 60 days focus on learning Column ’s products, customers, voice, and the public notice ecosystem, while quickly contributing to our content engine. You will: Learn Column ’s products, customer segments, positioning, marketing priorities, and the public notice landscape Review our existing blogs, newsletters, case studies, email programs, and sales enablement Take over the Marketing Calendar, Marketing Requests, and recurring content workflows Set up a regular check-in with CSMs and Services team to source insights and stories Build a news-monitoring routine for public notice legislation and public information developments By Day 60, you will have: Published 2 blog posts Published 2 newsletters Published 1 customer case study Published 2 LinkedIn posts Published 1 Public Notice report Responded to and managed incoming content and marketing requests Actively maintained and managed the Marketing Calendar By the end of your second month, you understand Column ’s voice, audience, products, and priorities—and can independently own standard content projects from request through publication. Days 61-90: Own and Build By your third month, you are independently running Column ’s content engine: a weekly blog, newsletters, the monthly Public Notice report, steady LinkedIn publishing, and timely news commentary for Glorion. By Day 90, you have published a second monthly Public Notice report, built a repeatable process with CSMs and Services for sourcing content, and established a consistent, recognizable Column voice across every channel. Must Haves 2+ years of experience in content marketing, B2B marketing, editorial, journalism, communications, or a related field Excellent writing, editing, research, and interviewing skills, with experience producing substantive long-form content Strong visual judgment and experience creating polished marketing assets in Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools Strong project management skills, including managing editorial calendars, multiple stakeholders, and competing deadlines A track record of publishing on a consistent cadence and owning projects from idea through distribution Nice to Haves Experience with lifecycle marketing platforms like and website tools like Framer Deeper experience with B2B SEO, original research, and A/B-tested email campaigns Experience covering legal, policy, or government news, or building a LinkedIn audience for a B2B brand Experience supporting PR, sponsored content, media, or industry partnerships Familiarity with government technology, legal technology, local media, public notice, or another regulated industry Compensation & Benefits Competitive salary: $80k-$100k based on experience 401K with match Health, dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability insurance Flexible PTO and fully remote work environment (U.S.-based) Originally posted on Himalayas

You'll work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, and Creative Strategists to develop content that captures attention, builds audiences, and drives engagement. We're looking for someone who understands TikTok beyond trends and viral sounds. You know how to identify content opportunities, develop repeatable formats, analyze performance, and turn insights into better creative decisions. If you're constantly discovering new creators, experimenting with content formats, and finding ways to make every video perform better than the last, you'll thrive in this role. What You'll Do Develop & Execute TikTok Content Strategies Develop and manage TikTok content strategies aligned with brand objectives, target audiences, and growth goals. Create and maintain content calendars, publishing schedules, and campaign plans. Research trending formats, sounds, hashtags, creators, and emerging content opportunities. Develop creative concepts, content series, and video ideas tailored to each brand's identity. Identify opportunities to improve organic reach, audience engagement, and follower growth. Manage Content Production Work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, Copywriters, and Creative Strategists to produce engaging TikTok videos. Oversee Publishing & Account Management Manage daily TikTok publishing activities across assigned brand accounts. Write engaging captions, select relevant hashtags, and optimize posts for discoverability. Ensure content is published consistently and according to the content calendar. Monitor comments, audience interactions, and emerging conversations to identify engagement opportunities. Maintain a consistent brand voice across all published content. Analyze Content Performance Monitor key performance metrics, including views, watch time, retention, engagement rate, follower growth, and conversions. Identify top-performing content and develop strategies to replicate successful formats. Analyze underperforming videos and recommend improvements to hooks, pacing, storytelling, and creative execution. Prepare regular performance reports highlighting key insights, trends, and opportunities. Use performance data to continuously refine content strategies and improve results. Stay Ahead of TikTok Trends Monitor TikTok trends, algorithm updates, platform features, and changes in audience behavior. Research competitors and successful creators to identify emerging content strategies. Experiment with new formats, storytelling techniques, and creative approaches. Identify trends early and translate them into relevant content opportunities for our brands. Who You Are Experienced TikTok Content Professional 1-3 years of experience in TikTok content management, social media management, content strategy, or digital marketing. Proven experience managing TikTok accounts and developing content that generates meaningful engagement and audience growth. Experience working with DTC, eCommerce, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or consumer brands is highly preferred. A portfolio or examples of TikTok accounts you've managed and their performance results are required. Strong Creative Instincts Deep understanding of TikTok culture, trends, algorithms, and content formats. Strong ability to identify engaging hooks, compelling storytelling techniques, and creative concepts. Comfortable developing ideas for both organic content and performance-driven advertising. Familiarity with TikTok Shop, creator collaborations, and influencer marketing is a plus. Data-Driven & Results-Oriented Experience using TikTok Analytics and social media management platforms. Strong understanding of content performance metrics and how to translate insights into actionable strategies. Comfortable testing different creative approaches and making decisions based on performance data. Organized & Collaborative Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, content calendars, and production deadlines. Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with creators, editors, and cross-functional teams. Comfortable providing creative feedback and managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Creative, Resourceful & Adaptable You're constantly exploring new ideas and finding opportunities to improve content performance. You enjoy experimenting with new formats and aren't afraid to challenge conventional creative approaches. You anticipate production needs, take ownership of projects, and find solutions when priorities change. You bring fresh ideas and energy to every project and enjoy working with a team that's always looking to raise the bar. Perks & Benefits Work with Leading Brands: Develop TikTok strategies and content for exciting lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wellness, and DTC brands. Creative Ownership: Take an active role in shaping content strategies, developing original concepts, and experimenting with new creative formats. Career Growth: Expand your expertise in social media strategy, creative production, influencer marketing, and performance advertising, with opportunities to advance into senior content and creative leadership roles. Collaborative Creative Environment: Work alongside talented Content Creators, Video Editors, Creative Strategists, and marketing professionals. A Culture of Innovation: Join a team that moves quickly, embraces experimentation, and values people who bring fresh ideas and turn them into results. High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe exceptional creative work comes from different perspectives, experiences, and ideas. If you're passionate about TikTok, excited by creative experimentation, and motivated by building content that delivers measurable results, we'd love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

input.description: Build a YouTube system that turns founder ideas into qualified growth We are hiring a hands-on YouTube strategist and channel lead to own Eric Siu's long-form content system across AI, marketing, entrepreneurship, and business. Include “YouTube strategy is cool” in the subject line. Otherwise, your application will be disqualified. You will turn current ideas, X posts, podcasts, and weekly priorities into strong video angles, outlines, titles, thumbnail directions, and a reliable production pipeline. You will coordinate editors, thumbnail designers, researchers, and publishing support through completion. This is not an advisory role. You own the channel loop from idea selection through packaging, production, publishing recommendation, measurement, and the next decision. About Single Grain Single Grain is a revenue marketing agency. We build pipeline-focused systems that compound, not campaigns that expire. We have helped more than 500 companies, from venture-backed startups to the Fortune 500, drive measurable growth. Eric Siu hosts the Leveling Up podcast and co-hosts Marketing School with Neil Patel. The content reaches marketers, founders, and operators across YouTube, podcasts, email, and social platforms. We operate as an AI-native team. Every role uses AI to improve speed, quality, judgment, and leverage. AI output still requires strong human taste and quality control. Your mission Build and run a long-form YouTube operating system that publishes up to three strong videos per week, improves packaging and retention, and creates qualified audience action. Primary KPI: improve qualified YouTube actions from the first-30-day baseline while maintaining a reliable production cadence. Supporting metrics include impressions, click-through rate, first-30-second retention, average percentage viewed, qualified CTA actions, and attributed leads. What you will own Audit the channel, archive, audience, offer paths, analytics, and production workflow. Build a rolling topic and packaging pipeline from Eric's current ideas and source material. Produce at least three title and thumbnail routes for each approved video. Turn selected topics into practical outlines without requiring Eric to write scripts. Coordinate researchers, editors, thumbnail designers, and publishing support through delivery. Run documented packaging and content tests and use the results to improve the next batch. Connect each content cluster to a relevant lead path instead of optimizing for views alone. Lead the weekly channel review and maintain a four-week forward pipeline. Build AI-assisted research, packaging, outlining, briefing, and analysis workflows with strong human QA. Document what to scale, stop, or change. What success looks like In 30 days, you have completed the audit, set the baseline, built the first rolling pipeline, and established clear owners and deadlines. By 60 days, the team can publish up to three strong long-form videos per week, every approved video has multiple packaging routes, and tests produce useful learning. By 90 days, you own the full channel system with minimal handholding and can show measurable improvement in packaging, retention, production reliability, or qualified lead actions. Evidence we need to see Recent channel strategy work for B2B, AI, SaaS, business, entrepreneur, marketing, finance, or expert-led creators. Strong, current title and thumbnail examples with the thinking and result behind them. Evidence that you turned rough founder ideas into angles, outlines, and published videos. End-to-end ownership of a production team, deadlines, approvals, and quality control. One quantified result tied to qualified audience growth, email, booked calls, pipeline, sales, revenue, or another business outcome. A concrete AI-assisted workflow and the judgment to reject weak output. High agency: you define the path, solve workflow problems, test ideas, and close the loop. This role is not A consultant who gives feedback and leaves execution to someone else. A project coordinator who cannot make packaging or content decisions. A thumbnail-only, SEO-only, or analytics-only role. A views-only role that ignores audience quality and lead paths. A role that waits for Eric to supply finished scripts and manage the team. How the process works Application and evidence review. A focused screen against the role outcomes. A paid strategy exercise based on one real topic: three title and thumbnail routes, one recommended angle, a practical outline, CTA path, and production handoff. A live review of your choices, tradeoffs, evidence, and iteration. References and final decision. The paid exercise is timeboxed and will not be used as unpaid production work. Work model and compensation This is a fully remote, part-time contractor role. Applicants must state their weekly capacity, available working hours, start date, and compensation expectations. input.description: About Ritual Ritual is a personal health brand that is raising the bar for daily wellness. Known for our best-selling, clinically backed prenatal, we create science-backed supplements with transparency at their core. We believe women deserve products they can trust, backed by real evidence—not just promises. We started by reinventing the multivitamin with the first visible supply chain of its kind. Today, we’re expanding into new categories with the same high standards that built our reputation. Hundreds of thousands trust Ritual , and we’re growing fast. Our team of 120+ scientists, creatives, and skeptics is raising the bar for women’s health. We’re venture-backed, based in sunny Los Angeles, and always looking for people ready to challenge the industry—and do the best work of their careers. About the role As Senior Manager, Performance Creative, you will own the creative engine behind Ritual 's paid acquisition, accountable for one outcome: creative that efficiently acquires new customers at scale. Reporting to the Director of Growth Marketing, you will set our performance creative strategy, lead a Growth Creative Strategist and an in-house team of creatives, and direct a roster of external creative agencies and creator partners. Together, you will turn performance data, customer insight and culture into a steady pipeline of winning ads across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and emerging channels. This is a player-coach role. You will set the bar for great performance creative at Ritual , coach internal and external partners to meet it, and stay close enough to the work to brief, critique and approve it yourself. What you'll do Own creative performance outcomes: You will be accountable for creative's contribution to customer acquisition cost, measured through hit rate, testing velocity, the volume and diversity of new concepts in market, and efficiency metrics such as CPMR, CVR, CAC, and hook rate. Set the strategy and roadmap: Build quarterly and monthly performance creative roadmap tied to acquisition goals, product launches and promotional moments. Decide which angles, audiences (micro and macro), formats and channels get prioritized. Translate business objectives and customer insight into messaging angles and briefs that address real pain points, differentiators and product education needs. Lead and develop your team: Manage and coach a Growth Creative Strategist and an in-house team of video, motion and design creatives. Set clear priorities, give direct feedback, and grow the team's strategic range so it gets stronger. Direct external creative partners: Own the relationships, scopes, briefs and output quality across our creative agencies, creators, and UGC and KOL programs. Hold partners accountable to volume, timelines and performance, and decide when to scale, restructure or replace one. Run a disciplined testing program: Own the creative testing framework across hooks, formats, offers, audiences and funnel stages, from hypothesis to read to next iteration. Use creative analytics (such as Motion) and platform data to decide what to stop, improve or scale, and bring new formats, creator models, AI-assisted production and emerging channels into the mix with a clear test plan. Build the creative operating system: Forecast creative volume and refresh cadence based on spend, campaign priorities and creative fatigue. Build scalable systems for intake, briefing, naming, tagging, reporting and knowledge sharing, so what we learn from each test reaches the whole team and every partner. Approve, align and communicate: Serve as the final approver for performance creative before launch, in partnership with our Creative and Regulatory teams. Work closely with paid media, brand, product marketing, and analytics, and present creative strategy and results to senior leadership. Who you are Accountable: You own the result, not just the process. You put a number on success and are comfortable being measured against it. A coach and inclusive partner: You make the people around you better through clear direction, honest feedback and respect, and you help strategists grow into leaders. Creative and analytical: You can tell a great hook from a good one, and you can prove it with data. Systems-minded: You build the processes that let a team and its partners scale output without losing quality or clarity. Decisive and resilient: You make calls with imperfect information, stop what isn't working, and double down on what is. Curious and growth-oriented: You track platform changes, cultural trends and competitor creative, and you turn them into tests, not just ideas. Brand-minded and principled: You know performance creative can drive efficiency and build the brand at the same time. input.location: Remote · Brazil, Canada, India, Kenya, Mexico, Nigeria, South Africa, Ukraine, United States
input.description: This is the Sign You’ve Been Looking For Tired of creating content for businesses that don’t align with your core values? At KindWiseRich , we’re on a mission to change the narrative. Here, you’ll craft content that spreads kindness, wisdom, and financial literacy —helping people become more kind, wise, and financially independent empowered to live their best lives. About Us KindWiseRich is an international media company producing meaningful content for YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram. Our work is grounded in practical value, evidence, and studies, designed to educate, inspire, and unite people globally. Our team operates remotely across 12 countries - Ukraine, England, Ireland, Scotland , the USA, Canada, Brazil, Mexico, Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya and India - bringing diverse perspectives to everything we create. Our Mission To inspire, educate, and unite people worldwide by creating content that fosters kindness, wisdom, and prosperity, empowering individuals to live their best lives and make a meaningful difference together. Our Vision We believe the world needs more than entertainment. While entertainment has its place, we’re building a platform for educational content that is grounded in scientific truth , provides maximum practical value , and is easy for anyone to understand and act upon. About Our Team Our team includes professionals who have worked with some of the world’s most prestigious brands , including Apple, Sony PlayStation, Warner Brothers, Toyota, Nestlé, PwC, Spotify, LucasArts, Activision, Meta, Twitter, TikTok, PepsiCo, IKEA, eBay, Lays, Mars, IBM, Nissan, FC Barcelona, Coca-Cola, Cisco, Procter & Gamble, and Ford. Our team has earned prestigious awards like the Emmy and Eurobest Gold and contributed to high-profile campaigns for the NBA, Super Bowl, Beyoncé, and other renowned brands and talents. Our Culture At KindWiseRich, we live by these core values: Kindness : We uplift each other and our audience with positivity. Wisdom : We value learning and growing from every experience. Teamwork : Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Autonomy : We trust our team to manage their work with creativity and independence. Fun : Work should be enjoyable. We make it so. Reliability : We deliver what we promise, on time, every time. We believe in building an environment where the most talented people feel free to create, collaborate, and thrive —while having fun along the way. The Role: Content Creators About the Role: We are seeking a creative and strategic Content Creator to produce engaging and compelling content across multiple platforms. The ideal candidate has a passion for storytelling, a strong understanding of digital media trends, and the ability to adapt content to different audiences and platforms. Key Responsibilities: Develop, write, and edit high-quality content for websites, blogs, social media, email campaigns, videos, podcasts, and other marketing materials. Collaborate with marketing, design, and product teams to align content with brand voice, style, and strategic goals. Manage the content calendar, ensuring consistent publishing schedules. Conduct research on industry-related topics to generate ideas and support content creation. Optimize content for SEO and digital marketing best practices. Engage with audiences on social media platforms and contribute to community-building efforts. Track content performance metrics and adjust strategies based on analytics and user feedback. Stay updated with the latest trends in digital content, social media, and marketing. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field. Proven experience as a Content Creator, Copywriter, or similar role. Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills. Familiarity with SEO principles and content management systems (e.g., WordPress, HubSpot). Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Basic knowledge of graphic design, video editing, or social media management tools is a plus (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite). Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Preferred Skills: Creativity and the ability to generate innovative ideas. Strong storytelling and visual communication skills. Proficiency in multimedia content creation (photos, videos, infographics). Experience with analytics tools (Google Analytics, social media insights). Knowledge of paid media, influencer marketing, or affiliate programs. What Kind of Content Will You Create? At KindWiseRich, you’ll be crafting a variety of engaging content that makes a real difference. Here’s what you’ll be working on (depending on your specialization): Short 5-Minute Videos: Bite-sized yet powerful narratives designed to inspire and educate. Shorts: Impactful videos for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts that pack a punch in under a minute. Social Media Posts: Engaging visuals and captions that spark conversation and connection. Infographics and Pictures: Eye-catching graphics that simplify complex ideas into shareable insights. Articles: In-depth, thought-provoking pieces that dive deeper into topics of kindness, wisdom, and financial literacy. Each piece of content is an opportunity to connect with people, challenge norms, and empower our audience to make real changes in their lives. By joining us, you’re not just creating content—you’re building a legacy of impact. Who Are We Looking For? We want teammates who embody: Reliability : You deliver high-quality work on time, every time. Positivity : No drama or toxicity—just a team of easy-going human beings. Transparency : If you face challenges, you let the team know and work through them together. Innovation : Comfortable leveraging tools like AI to enhance workflows and creativity. What We Offer A Better You : your professional deformation may cause unexpected side effects like becoming kinder, wiser, and richer. Consult your friends if symptoms of excessive empathy, wisdom, or financial savvy persist. Make a Difference : Your work will inspire, educate, and empower a global audience. Collaborate with the Best : Work alongside a talented, award-winning team. Global Experience : Gain multicultural insights by collaborating with teammates from six countries. Flexibility : Work remotely and manage your schedule your way. Our Conditions Location : Remote Commitment : 10-15 hours per week (volunteer, pro bono at the start). About Our Hiring Process It’s simple. We’ll have one informal call —more like a virtual coffee chat—where we’ll answer your questions and learn about you. Expect no boring interview questions, just conversations like: "What’s your favorite book?" "What’s your favorite social cause?" Please, Read Carefully This is a volunteer position . While unpaid for now, we are committed to compensating our team as soon as we achieve our financial milestones. If you’re not in a position to volunteer, that’s okay, and you shouldn’t feel bad about it. This role is best suited for those who are financially stable and want to contribute to a meaningful project while learning, growing, and making a real impact. Why Is This a Volunteer Position? We believe in full transparency and intentionality in how we operate. Here’s why we’re asking for your passion and dedication on a volunteer basis: Inspiring Future Creators: We’re on a mission to inspire millions of future creators to pursue their passions—even when they face financial challenges, lack connections, or don’t have access to resources. Our story reflects this spirit: KindWiseRich was founded by one audacious dreamer from Ukraine who intentionally avoided using personal networks or raising funds from investors, proving that success can come from collaboration with like-minded people and creative approach how to manage the company without selling one's own organs. Independence Over Investors. We’ve chosen not to rely on investor funding because our independence and creative freedom are non-negotiable. This allows us to create content that genuinely serves and empowers people—not content that panders to shareholder demands or profit-driven agendas. Transparency About Compensation. When KindWiseRich begins to monetize, our first priorities will be reinvesting in growth, paying taxes, and building a sustainable model. Only then will we start compensating our team members. While the first wave of compensation might be modest, we have a clear roadmap to grow KindWiseRich into a platform with millions of followers and greater financial rewards for everyone involved. But we want to be upfront—it will take time, and we can’t promise it will happen overnight. Joining us now means you’re not just part of a team; you’re part of a movement. Ready to Join Us? While you’re thinking, others are already applying. Don’t miss your chance to create something extraordinary with KindWiseRich. It may not be a chance anymore. We build long-term relationships, and do not plan to renew the search for this role without an objective reasons. We focus not on quantity, but on quality of people. Together, let’s transform the world through storytelling that inspires, educates, and empowers. Originally posted on Himalayas

input.description: Description OpenDor Media is searching for a Director of Events to own a growing calendar of live shows and donor events, from the first request to the final debrief, and turn each one into an experience worth showing up for. You will be the front door for every event request, work with our Chief Marketing Officer to set priorities and assign ownership, and run the room on site when it counts. Your work shapes how people experience OpenDor Media in person, and the events you deliver show people who we are and why our work matters. OpenDor Media is a leading global non-profit media company for the 21st century. We educate, entertain, and engage our audiences by bringing to life big ideas and authentic stories, and by celebrating all things Jewish. This role is an exempt, fully remote position that includes travel to events 1-2 times per month. What you'll own Flagship live shows: Be the person who makes each show happen: set the budget, secure approvals, book the venue and production team, and lead on site, working with Content and Development on the stage conversation, VIP reception and guest list. Donor events: Plan and deliver parlor events and donor gatherings in Los Angeles, New York, Miami and other cities, giving our Development team the right setting to deepen relationships with supporters. The events pipeline: Be the front door for every event request, recommending priorities to the Chief Marketing Officer so each event gets the right owner, investment and lead time, and keep one OpenDor Media events calendar. Support across the organization: Serve as Marketing's events liaison, bringing logistics and a consistent standard to speaking engagements, live episodes, tours and conferences led by division heads. Budgets and suppliers: Run the events budget, negotiate supplier contracts, and build the templates, checklists and trusted network of venues, caterers and AV partners that make each event easier than the last. Results and learning: Measure every event against its targets, from the right audience in the room to money raised within 90 days, and carry the lessons into the next plan. What we're looking for Strategic about where we show up: You think about audience, cost and payoff before logistics, and you help leadership put resources behind the events that matter most. A clear decision maker: You can look at a request and quickly shape the right plan for it, including the format, scale, owner and resources, and explain your thinking in a way people get behind. An owner from start to finish: You take an event from the first brief to the final debrief, handling the venue, suppliers, run of show and day-of details yourself so nothing falls through the cracks. Calm in the room: When the AV fails or a speaker runs late, you are the steady voice running the show, and the guests never notice. Able to balance multiple priorities: You build the timeline, track every moving piece across teams and suppliers, and hold stakeholders to their dates without spending the goodwill that gets the next event done. Requirements You have 6+ years in live events, experiential marketing, agency production, nonprofit galas or live entertainment. You have run donor, VIP or high-net-worth events for 150 to 1,000 guests, end to end. You manage budgets and suppliers with confidence, including negotiating contracts. You keep complex, multi-stakeholder projects on schedule. You are based in the US, can travel one to two times a month, can work evenings and some weekends around events, and keep regular overlap with UK and Israel hours. You know AI and embrace it. You use AI tools to make your own work faster and cleaner, you have hands-on experience with Claude specifically. You write and speak fluent English and work comfortably in Google Workspace and Slack. You are committed to OpenDor Media 's mission and values. These are not required, but they help: Experience in a Jewish nonprofit or community organization or familiarity with Jewish and Israeli audiences Live podcast, broadcast or stage production experience Established venue and supplier networks in Miami, New York or Los Angeles Working knowledge of kashrut, Shabbat and Jewish holidays in event planning Experience with Wrike Who We Are: OpenDor Media provides inspiring and informative content on all issues relating to Judaism and Israel, and those that affect young Jews today. We are proudly and transparently positive about Israel and Zionism, Jewish values and ideals. We celebrate the riches of Jewish and Israeli history and culture. We do so in a voice which is authentic, credible and therefore trusted. We embrace complexity and recognize and give voice to multiple perspectives on difficult issues. We push the boundaries of innovation, creativity and good old hard work. From our leadership team to new and veteran team members, we all strive to embody our core values: Fueled by creativity: We think and act creatively in everything we do, with the agility and flexibility to apply creativity whatever role we play. Inspired by excellence : We are driven to excel at whatever we do. Our teams are always ready to go the extra mile to get the very best results. Powered by positivity: We bring positivity to work every day, for a fun, creative and inviting work environment that brings out the best in everyone. Driven by self-improvement: Like our content, no issue is taboo, and we are open to constructive ways to improve and develop into the best professionals we can be. Empowered by collaboration: We thrive on sharing knowledge, teamwork, being a “mensch,” and leveraging everyone's talents to achieve a sum greater than the parts. Benefits Fully remote with flexibility to work from anywhere Competitive salary Paid days off for Jewish and national holidays with vacation and sick time available from your first day Comprehensive Healthcare coverage 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match High level of autonomy and direct access to leadership A warm, collaborative culture and great colleagues Salary The salary for this position is $100,000 to $125,000 annually for a U.S.-based candidate. The final salary will be determined based on careful consideration of several factors, including the candidate's location, experience in similar roles, and expertise related to the qualifications above. You'll turn data into ideas, produce ads with AI tools, and see your work running in front of real audiences every week. This role is for you if… You've made performance ads, not just brand work, and you can show what won and why. AI tools are part of how you produce every day, not an experiment. You love the loop: idea, ad, result, better idea. You'd rather ship ten good variants this week than one perfect ad next month. You want to build a creative engine from the ground up on a small team. Why now The iFIT app is early and growing, and paid acquisition is scaling. We're building a lean, AI-first user acquisition team, and creative is the engine. You'll be one of its first hires and set how it works. Summary iFIT 's vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health (physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery) into a seamless interactive experience. What's scarce is knowing which ad to make and why, and learning quickly from every test. This role combines both: the strategy of a performance creative strategist and the hands-on output of a producer. It isn't a brand creative role, and it isn't a briefing-only role. You'll ship ads every week. Role Commitments Year-one outcomes, each with a measurable target agreed in your first 30 days: Run a high-volume testing cadence. Launch a steady weekly flow of new concepts and variants across paid channels. Find and scale winners. Raise the share of spend going to winning creative, and replace fatigued ads before performance drops. Build the AI production pipeline. Set up the tools, templates and workflows that let one person produce at the volume of a small team. Turn results into insight. Keep a living record of which audiences, hooks, offers and formats win, and share it with the Director of UA and Brand, Product & Partner Marketing. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Creative strategy (~30%) Turn audience insight, performance data and market trends into hooks, angles, offers and concepts for app acquisition. Own the creative testing roadmap with the Director of UA: what to test, in what order, and what we expect to learn. AI-assisted production (~40%) Produce static, video and UGC-style ads yourself, using AI image, video, voice and editing tools alongside standard design software. Create variants at volume: formats, lengths, hooks, languages and sizes for each platform. Brief and manage freelancers, UGC creators and vendors when work needs more capacity or higher craft. Use AI within iFIT 's policies on AI use, data privacy and intellectual property, including rights to likenesses, music and trainer content. Testing and analysis (~30%) Work with channel managers to launch, read and iterate on creative tests. Analyze creative performance (hook rate, CTR, CPI, CAC and conversion) and decide what to scale, iterate on or kill. Spot creative fatigue early and keep a pipeline of replacements ready. A weekly testing rhythm with the channel managers is in place. Brand guidelines and the review turnaround with Brand, Product & Partner Marketing are agreed. A baseline for creative performance (hook rate, CTR, CPI) is set by channel. In your first 90 days Your AI production pipeline is running, delivering new concepts and variants every week. At least one new winning concept has scaled across channels. Freelance and UGC creator support is set up for surge capacity. A shared record of winning audiences, hooks, offers and formats is in use. By the end of your first year Winning creative drives a growing share of spend, and fatigued ads are replaced before performance drops. Testing volume has grown without adding headcount. Creative learnings regularly shape acquisition messaging and brand positioning. A bias toward action: comfortable owning ambiguity and building process rather than waiting for one to be handed to you. Why This Role Matters at Stord Social is becoming one of the most trusted channels for B2B buyers and talent alike, and this role is a bet on that shift. input.description: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there—as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. As a Senior Manager, Social and Creator Marketing at BetterHelp , you’ll join our Brand Team alongside a diverse group of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll help shape how BetterHelp shows up in culture and how our brand reaches people organically—building the strategy, channels, partnerships, and systems that turn great brand ideas into sustained attention, conversation, and relevance. As a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp , you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day—with a supportive community behind you the whole way. What are we looking for? We’re looking for an experienced brand marketer and content distribution strategist to lead BetterHelp ’s organic brand presence and help more of our ideas travel. You’ll own the strategy for how BetterHelp builds attention, relevance, and community across owned and earned channels—from social and creators to partnerships, community, long-form content, PR amplification, and emerging platforms. You’ll think beyond individual posts or influencer campaigns to build an interconnected organic ecosystem: identifying where our audiences spend time, what they care about, what BetterHelp has permission to say, and how the right ideas can reach the right people. This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, culture, content, and distribution. You’ll pair strong creative instincts with a rigorous understanding of channels and audiences, helping BetterHelp create work that people actively choose to engage with, share, and participate in. What will you do? Own BetterHelp ’s organic brand and distribution strategy , defining how the brand earns attention and builds relevance across social, creators, partnerships, community, long-form content, PR amplification, and emerging channels. Build an audience-first distribution model that identifies where our audiences spend time, how they consume and share content, and which channels and formats are best suited to different brand ideas. Turn brand strategy into channel strategy , translating BetterHelp ’s positioning, campaigns, and cultural point of view into distinctive platform-native programs and always-on content. Develop the organic amplification strategy for major brand moments , working closely with Brand, Creative, PR, Partnerships, and Growth teams to extend campaigns beyond their initial launch and maximize their cultural reach and lifespan. Lead our owned social strategy across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn, establishing clear roles for each channel and continuously evolving our approach based on audience behavior and platform shifts. Lead creator and influencer strategy as a core organic distribution channel , developing thoughtful programs and long-term relationships that give creators meaningful ways to participate in and extend the BetterHelp brand. Build relationships with creators, cultural voices, communities, and partners who authentically align with our mission and can help BetterHelp participate in relevant conversations. Identify new and emerging distribution opportunities , testing new platforms, formats, communities, partnerships, and content models that can expand BetterHelp ’s organic reach. Develop a strategy for long-form and search-driven brand content , including YouTube, podcasts, SEO/AEO, and other formats that can compound audience and brand value over time. Create an international organic distribution strategy , identifying which approaches can scale globally and where local platforms, creators, cultural context, and audience behaviors require a differentiated approach. Lead planning for organic brand activations and cultural moments , including creator programs, events, partnerships, and community-led initiatives designed to generate participation and earned conversation. Act as the connective tissue across organic, earned, and paid distribution , ensuring strong ideas move effectively across channels while maintaining a consistent brand strategy and point of view. Partner closely with Growth and Paid Social teams to identify organic content, creators, formats, and audience insights that can inform paid amplification—while using performance learnings to sharpen organic strategy. Develop measurement frameworks for organic brand impact , looking beyond surface-level engagement to understand audience growth, conversation, share of attention, content velocity, brand impact, and the downstream value of organic distribution. Manage and mentor a growing team across organic social, creators, and related distribution functions, establishing clear priorities, operating rhythms, and opportunities for development. Manage budgets and external partners across creators, agencies, partnerships, content production, and brand activations, ensuring investments ladder back to a clear distribution strategy. Build scalable operating systems , including briefs, playbooks, channel frameworks, compliance guardrails, measurement systems, and AI-assisted workflows that allow the team to increase its impact without proportional headcount growth. Partner with Legal and Compliance to develop practical frameworks for social, creator, and organic content across US and international markets. Stay deeply connected to culture and the evolving media landscape , bringing emerging behaviors, platforms, creators, communities, and distribution models back into BetterHelp ’s brand strategy. What will you NOT do? You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success. You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do. You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here! You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really. Can I work remotely? Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel. Benefits Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company Competitive compensation Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more) Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage 401k benefits with employer matching contribution The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive An awesome community of co-workers The base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $200,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions. At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status. Notice to Candidates: BetterHelp has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team – please know that we have no affiliation or connection to these situations. We only post open roles on our career page () or reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages, and all official BetterHelp recruitment emails will come from the domain @. Our commitment is to ensure a safe and transparent hiring experience for all candidates. We will never ask you for money, gift cards, or any form of payment during our hiring process, and we will never send money or checks to candidates. If you experience this, it is a scam. Coordinate content scheduling, publishing, and approvals in collaboration with the client and internal stakeholders. Content Planning & Development Develop creative content ideas, concepts, and recommendations tailored to the client's brand and audience. Work with the client, internal teams, and external creative partners to gather and organize content for social media use.
